scope: Only delta from reviewed native.ts6b1edc5e… to current fixed missing-executable regression and lifecycle evidence. No repeated full-source acceptance.

observations.assessment: The only new mode is the literal union normal|missing-executable, checked again at runtime. The alternate execPath is a fixed sibling path resolved from import.meta.url and must not exist before fork. No pathname, executable, DB transport or mode is accepted from IPC/runtime input; the normal path remains unchanged.

observedError is assigned only by the actual ChildProcess error listener, observedClose only by actual close, and observedExit only by actual exit. The test requires actual ENOENT, non-null close, null exit and undefined child PID. It does not synthesize process events or assert a fabricated successful exit.

The command is observed immediately and dispose must reject visibly. Disposal awaits real close, drains parent read jobs and keeps any startup/send failure fatal. A generic send failure may remain the primary fatal while a separately captured actual ENOENT proves the intended spawn failure; this is explicitly visible in the source and never interpreted as success.

After joining actual close and owned jobs, the source clears the watchdog and removes its stop callback plus named message/exit/error/disconnect/stdout/stderr listeners. The regression asserts joined/timerReleased/listenersReleased, actual owned-listener absence, zero pending jobs/reads, removal from tracked children, globally empty children set and no additional SQL dispatch.
